anomalies.observed: R57's schematic Value field is '24k' (and the SPICE deck uses 24k), but the same component's MPN is 'FRC0805J240TSD' (EIA 240 = 24 Ω) and its Description reads '24Ω ±5%' in an R_0805 (125 mW) footprint. R57 is wired directly across the rectified DC input rails VOUTP and VOUTN.
anomalies.expected: The value field, MPN and description must agree. R57 sits as a bleed/discharge resistor across the bridge-rectifier DC output (VOUTP/VOUTN), so a high value (~24 kΩ) is intended; a 24 Ω part in 0805 would dissipate ~6 W at 12 V (far above the 125 mW rating) and heavily load the supply, which is not a sensible design.
anomalies.impact: If the board is assembled to the MPN/description (24 Ω) rather than the schematic value (24 kΩ), a 24 Ω load is placed across the rectified motor/DC input, drawing ~0.5 A at 12 V (~6 W) in a 125 mW 0805 package — overheating/burning the resistor and loading the supply, deviating from the intended high-value bleed.

parsed.summary: Most of the design matches the spec (16 MHz MCP2515 crystals Y3/Y5, 14.7456 MHz UART crystals Y2/Y4, SM712 TVS on CAN, LTC4412+PMOS ideal-diode, SN74LVC1G07 e-stop buffers). The one clear deviation is R57, whose schematic value (24 k) contradicts its MPN/description (24 Ω) across the rectified DC input — a 1000× mismatch that, if sourced per the MPN, would put an over-dissipating load on the power input.
